plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for RACOM transmission device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, interface traffic, and voltage, for RAy3 (enterprise PEN 33555).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: cpu_usage_percent
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the RACOM RAy3 microwave unit (RacomRay3 useCpu under PEN 33555), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage with no scaling. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate wireless backhaul traffic pressure, control-plane load or abnormal traffic.

metrics.name: memory_usage_percent
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the RACOM RAy3 microwave unit (RacomRay3 useMemory under PEN 33555), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage with no scaling. Sustained high memory usage may indicate control-plane resource pressure or unstable device services.

metrics.name: modem_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Modem-board temperature of the RACOM RAy3 microwave unit in degrees Celsius (RacomRay3 temperatureModem under PEN 33555). The SNMP scalar reports hundredths of a degree, so the query divides the raw value by 100. High values may indicate cooling problems, high ambient temperature or overloaded hardware.

metrics.name: radio_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Optional radio-module temperature of the RACOM RAy3 microwave unit in degrees Celsius (RacomRay3 temperatureRadio under PEN 33555). The SNMP scalar reports hundredths of a degree, so the query divides the raw value by 100. Some firmware revisions omit this object; missing rows are skipped. High values may indicate RF hardware thermal stress.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Optional power-supply voltage of the RACOM RAy3 microwave unit in volts (RacomRay3 voltageUnit under PEN 33555). The SNMP scalar reports tenths of a volt, so the query divides the raw value by 10. Readings far from the rated DC input indicate brownout, wiring faults or a failing supply.

metrics.name: rss_dbm
metrics.description: Optional received signal strength of the RACOM RAy3 microwave link in dBm (RacomRay3 rss under PEN 33555). The SNMP scalar reports tenths of a dBm (for example -39 means -3.9 dBm), so the query divides the raw value by 10. A dropping RSS is an early sign of path fade, antenna misalignment or radio degradation.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
